$comment: Authoring input for `npm run sprites:emotions`. Nothing here ships to the browser — it
is the prompt book for the Ludo.ai generator, and the record of what each clip was asked
to be, so a re-run reproduces the same intent.
Prompt rules learned the hard way, keep to them:
- Describe POSTURE, not expression. A Trial sprite's face is 50-80px on screen; a raised
eyebrow is invisible and asking for one just wastes the model's attention.
- Say 'in place', 'no travel'. Left unsaid, the model walks the animal out of frame and
the clip cannot loop against a static stage slot.
- Framing comes from each animal's `view`, never from the prompt text: the cast is NOT
uniformly side-on. The owl is drawn front-facing and the raccoon's sitting pose is a
three-quarter — telling either of them 'side view, facing left' asks the generator to
turn the character, and the clip then will not cut against its own idle loop.
- Keep the silhouette. The reference frame carries the character; the prompt should only
ever move it.
- Never name a posture the animal has to CHANGE STATE to reach. 'Crouched low' made the
generator lie the donkey down over the clip and never stand it back up: a transition,
not a held attitude, and one that cannot loop. Say what the body does while it stays
where it is, and say outright what it must not do ('never lies down').
- Watch the height swing in the review output. The runtime scales a clip off one union
bounding box, so a character whose height wanders 20%+ across frames renders too small
for most of the clip however good it looks in isolation.

talking.prompt: {view}. The {species} stays in place and talks: head bobbing gently in time with speech, mouth opening and closing, body relaxed and weight even. Small, steady, conversational. Seamless loop, no travel, same silhouette throughout.

doubtful.prompt: {view}. The {species} stays in place and reacts with skepticism: weight shifting back away from the listener, head drawing back and tilting slightly, a slow doubtful shake of the head. Unconvinced, guarded. Seamless loop, no travel, same silhouette throughout.

angry.prompt: {view}. The {species} stays in place and is angry: weight driving forward, head lowered and thrust toward the target, body tensed and shoulders squared, sharp agitated movement. Seamless loop, no travel, same silhouette throughout.

thinking.prompt: {view}. The {species} stays in place and thinks: nearly still, head lowered and turned slightly away, a slow considering nod, weight settled. Quiet and deliberate. Seamless loop, no travel, same silhouette throughout.

sneaky.prompt: {view}. The {species} stays standing on all fours the entire time and speaks conspiratorially: head craned forward and dipped toward the listener, ears flattening back, eyes flicking sideways mid-sentence. Sly, secretive, up to something. It never lies down, never sits, never lowers its body. Starts and ends in the exact pose of the reference image. Seamless loop, no travel, same silhouette throughout.

raccoon.$comment: Staged sitting up on the Trial stand (`idleTrial`), so the reference is the sitting pose, not the four-legged crouch — an emotion clip generated from the crouch would pop the moment the debate cuts to it.

angry.prompt: {view}. The raccoon stays sitting upright in place and is angry: chest thrust forward, head lowered and jabbing toward the target, forepaws gesturing sharply. Seamless loop, no travel, same silhouette throughout.

sneaky.prompt: {view}. The raccoon stays sitting upright in place and speaks conspiratorially: hunching down over its forepaws, head dipped and craned forward, glancing furtively to the side. Sly and secretive. Seamless loop, no travel, same silhouette throughout.

owl.$comment: A perched bird has no gait and no shoulders to square, so the generic four-legged posture prompts read as nonsense here. Every emotion is rewritten around what an owl actually has: head rotation, hunching, and wings.

talking.prompt: {view}. The perched owl stays in place and talks: beak opening and closing, head bobbing slightly with each phrase, body still and upright. Seamless loop, no travel, same silhouette throughout.

doubtful.prompt: {view}. The perched owl stays in place and is skeptical: body leaning back, head rotating slowly away and tilting, a long unimpressed stare. Seamless loop, no travel, same silhouette throughout.

angry.prompt: {view}. The perched owl stays in place and is angry: body hunched forward and low over its perch, wings flaring and snapping shut, head thrust out, beak open. Seamless loop, no travel, same silhouette throughout.

thinking.prompt: {view}. The perched owl stays in place and thinks: almost motionless, head turning slowly to one side and back, a single slow blink. Seamless loop, no travel, same silhouette throughout.

sneaky.prompt: {view}. The perched owl stays in place and speaks conspiratorially: body hunched down and drawn in, head craned forward and dipped low, rotating to glance furtively behind it. Seamless loop, no travel, same silhouette throughout.
